# exo_authentication_policy (Resource)

Manages the AuthenticationPolicy object via New-AuthenticationPolicy / Get-AuthenticationPolicy / Set-AuthenticationPolicy / Remove-AuthenticationPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Optional

- `allow_basic_auth_active_sync` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBasicAuthActiveSync parameter.
- `allow_basic_auth_autodiscover` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBasicAuthAutodiscover parameter.
- `allow_basic_auth_imap` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBasicAuthImap parameter.
- `allow_basic_auth_mapi` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBasicAuthMapi parameter.
- `allow_basic_auth_offline_address_book` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBasicAuthOfflineAddressBook parameter.
- `allow_basic_auth_outlook_service` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBasicAuthOutlookService parameter.
- `allow_basic_auth_pop` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBasicAuthPop parameter.
- `allow_basic_auth_powershell` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBasicAuthPowershell parameter.
- `allow_basic_auth_reporting_web_services` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBasicAuthReportingWebServices parameter.
- `allow_basic_auth_rpc` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBasicAuthRpc parameter.
- `allow_basic_auth_smtp` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBasicAuthSmtp parameter.
- `allow_basic_auth_web_services` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBasicAuthWebServices parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
